solutionSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
         COUNT(*)::integer AS shipments
  FROM shipments
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       shipments,
       (shipments - LAG(shipments) OVER (ORDER BY month))::integer AS change
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month;

rules.howSolved: There is no WHERE clause, so every shipment counts whatever its status.
booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' is applied before date_trunc('month') and to_char 'YYYY-MM', so month boundaries are UTC.
shipments minus LAG(shipments) OVER (ORDER BY month), over the months that have shipments.
LAG returns NULL for the first month, so its change is NULL.

ambiguities: A calendar month with no shipments produces no row here, so 'the previous month' means the previous month that has shipments. If a zero-count month should appear, the change values would differ; the text does not say.
notes: COUNT returns bigint, so the count and change are cast to integer to match the ticket's integer column types. Ran on sample, nulls and boundary with no errors.
